Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finance here at Stratus is trying to close the internal ticket for marketplace onboarding and they flagged a few items on the partner paper/order form that we need clarified before procurement will sign: 

1) Evidence for reseller commissions: they want a typical set of artifacts we’ll provide (invoices, commission reports, EOM statements) and whether Redwood can produce a consolidated monthly report for Stratus to reconcile.
2) Invoice routing and escrow: Stratus needs to confirm whether the marketplace pass-through means Redwood invoices Stratus or if payments flow directly through the marketplace. Also, our legal team asked for the escrow window (how long funds are held) when a reseller-style billing flow is used.
3) Audit evidence & retention: the order form lists a 24-month audit right — we need to know if Redwood can provide supporting documents within 10 business days.

Can you point me at the specific parts of the partner paper / order form that match these items or propose wording we can include in the SOW? Procurement is asking for a single point of contact and a list of sample attachments.

Appreciate the help — would prefer to get this resolved this week.

Best,

- Reseller commissions: we can provide consolidated monthly commission reports and PDF invoices. We can include a sample CSV template.
- Invoice routing: Redwood typically invoices the partner (marketplace) for pass-through listings; if Stratus needs the marketplace to invoice directly to your customers we can add an invoicing carveout.

- Audit turnaround: we can commit to producing supporting docs within 10 business days for standard requests, longer for legal subpoenas.

Karthik / Ben — can you draft a short evidence checklist (one page) and two optional contract clauses: (A) invoice routing options (Redwood invoiced / marketplace invoiced), and (B) escrow window (7 or 15 business days) plus sample language for the 24-month audit response SLA? Hi all,

I reviewed the partner paper and sketched proposed redlines. Summary below — I attached a one‑page redline summary and a draft clause for each item. Ben, please review the operational impacts.

1) Reseller commission evidence (clause: "Commission Reporting"): Redwood will provide a consolidated monthly commission report (CSV + PDF) within 5 business days of month-end. Reports will include invoice id, customer id, recognized revenue, reseller percentage, and calculation detail. We will retain supporting invoices for 24 months.

2) Invoice routing (clause: "Invoicing Flow"): Two mutually exclusive options are offered and selectable in the Order Form: (a) Redwood bills Stratus/Marketplace and remits payout to Stratus according to the agreed waterfall, or (b) Marketplace bills end customers directly and provides a pass-through payment confirmation to Redwood. We propose default (a) with an opt-in checkbox for (b). Add language for reconciliation cadence: monthly.

3) Escrow / settlement window (clause: "Settlement Hold Period"): Default hold = 7 business days after charge capture to allow for chargebacks/refunds. If Stratus requires a longer hold, select 15 business days in the Order Form. Redwood does not assume liability for funds held by marketplace escrow beyond stated hold period; parties may negotiate longer holds in the SOW.

4) Audit response SLA (clause: "Audit Assistance"): Redwood will provide reasonable evidence within 10 business days for standard commercial audits limited to transaction-level records relating to the reseller arrangement. Requests that require legal discovery processes or third-party subpoenas are handled separately and may take longer.

Operational notes:
- Ben, the 5-business-day report delivery requires a nightly ETL job and a scheduled report run — is that feasible?
- We should add an attachment naming the sample commission CSV fields and an example invoice.

If these redlines look ok to Stratus, I can incorporate them into the partner paper and push for a DocuSign cycle.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
